input.reason: Planning a pilot to test the claim that under fixed configuration A, flow completion time is 12 ms. Previous feedback flagged: (1) missing direction of added delay, and (2) lack of a replication unit. This proposal resolves both: delay is applied bidirectionally (ingress + egress on the emulated link), and the replication unit is defined as one independent flow per trial with N=10 trials. No new runners or equipment are invented; only the registered emulated-netem-v1 runner is used. All frozen inputs and configuration identities are preserved.

proposal.protocol: Pilot measurement of flow_completion_time_ms under fixed configuration A using emulated-netem-v1. Delay is applied bidirectionally (both egress and ingress directions on the emulated link) to resolve the previously flagged missing-direction issue. Replication unit is one independent TCP flow per trial; N=10 independent trials are run sequentially to provide a sample for mean and variance estimation. Configuration identity: config_A (frozen, as supplied in claim scope). No parameters are invented or modified beyond what is specified here.
proposal.hypothesis: Under fixed configuration A, the mean flow completion time equals 12 ms.
proposal.replication_unit: one independent TCP flow per trial
proposal.sample_size_rationale: N=10 pilot trials provide an initial estimate of mean and variance; sufficient to detect gross discrepancy from 12 ms without exceeding budget or attempt limits.
proposal.delay_direction: bidirectional (egress and ingress on emulated link)
proposal.algorithm: netem delay injection, fixed seed for reproducibility
proposal.controls: All other network parameters held constant per config_A; no background traffic injected.
proposal.exclusions: Trials that fail to complete (e.g., connection error) are recorded as missing and reported; no substitution.
proposal.missing_data_treatment: Missing trials reported as-is; if >2 of 10 fail, pilot is flagged inconclusive.
proposal.statistics: Report mean, standard deviation, min, max of flow_completion_time_ms across 10 trials. Trials are treated as independent (separately launched flows). No dependence assumed across trials.
proposal.sensitivity_applicability: Results apply only to the emulated environment under config_A; not generalizable to real-world or other configurations.
proposal.data_origin: emulated-netem-v1 runner output; synthetic evaluation context as noted in source limitations.
proposal.stopping_rule: Stop after 10 completed or attempted trials, or if cumulative spend reaches USD 10 (whichever comes first).
proposal.resource_limits: Maximum USD 10 for this pilot; maximum 5 additional attempts.
proposal.prior_exposure: No prior runs recorded for this claim.
proposal.coverage_limits: A narrow pilot under emulated conditions cannot settle a broad real-world claim; assessment will be limited accordingly.
proposal.dates: To be executed within the 7-day elapsed window ending 2026-10-25.

claims.quote: Under fixed configuration A, completion time is 12 ms.
